added.summary: World-anchored UI nodes now support distance scaling (scaleAt, scaleMin, scaleMax), depth culling (maxDistance), and LOD state bands (lod -> data-lod-near, data-lod-mid, data-lod-far); Nameplate and InteractionPrompt wire maxDistance directly.
HudEditorScreen now supports interactive pointer-draggable and keyboard-nudgeable HUD regions inside the safe-area guide frame with grid snapping and a scale, opacity, and visibility inspector dock.

Re-exported previously internal controls (Accordion, Collapsible, ContextMenu, DropdownMenu, List, MenuItem, MenuLabel, MenuSeparator, NumberInput, Popover, Radio, RadioGroup, Sheet, Tab, ToastStack, Toggle, ToggleGroup, Toolbar, ToolbarSeparator) from the components barrel.

fixed.summary: Unified the default UI pack and built-in components under a modern rounded clean glass language (Panel.frame, Plate.frame, Slot.frame, Chip.frame, Row.frame, overlays, buttons, and HUD bars), removing hardcoded cut-corner nine-slices, Tailwind fixed radii, asymmetric corners, double borders, and widthless border colour classes.

Fixed reactivity freezes, semantic ink ordering over Plate.frame, SVG/Line viewBox geometry, contrast, layout, focusGroup navigation, safe-area insets, and broken group-data-* selectors across built-in HUD, world, genre, and menu components.

UI presentation checkpoints now save and restore Tree interactive state (focus, keyboard modality, open modal stack, focusMemory, scroll offsets, Input text/caret, UI sound PRNG, and virtual cursor) alongside stores and feedback PRNG.

fixed: og check (OG9105) now loads the project look's UI theme/style and game theme.json when checking TSX class names; og style list/add discovers pack.json packs and templates/themes recipes; og ui eject copies and imports sibling locale .ogt tables and rewires all exported symbols and barrel aliases.
